title: Scarcity breaks when the world is already full
summary: Comparison weakens when every form is seen as already filled. Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
takeaway: Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
lifeApplication: When envy rises, step away from the screen and return the mind to one truthful task already in your hands today.

source.lifeApplication: When comparison narrows you, look again for the One already filling the scene.
